caption: The drawing depicts a wall-mounted wooden shelf with an attached mirror. The wood is rendered in shades of brown, showing grain patterns and carved, ornate details, especially around the mirror and the lower support structure. The mirror has a pointed arch shape at the top, and its frame is intricately cut with gothic-style curves and openings. The shelf below the mirror has a rounded front, and it appears to be solid and smoothly finished. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color, creating contrast with the brown shades of the wooden object. There are no other objects or details present in the composition.
title: Mahogany Shaving Mirror
